_comment_purpose: Infra-managed Capacitor configuration stub. Sits alongside the app-level mobile/capacitor.config.json (Phase K Wave 2 — the Capacitor shell's runtime config). This infra-side stub captures the ENVIRONMENT-bound knobs (server URLs, log levels, feature flags) that the W16 mobile-bundle-ci.yml workflow injects into the runtime bundle at CI time via the Capacitor 6 'configFile' override mechanism. See docs/mobile-ci-bootstrap.md §3 for the per-environment override matrix.
_comment_layout: The infra/mobile/ directory is the apone-lane home for Capacitor / Cordova / native-shell wiring. The mobile/ directory is the app-lane home for the actual Capacitor runtime (proximate to package.json + the iOS/Android scaffolding). Splitting them lets Stephen's infra-side per-env overrides land WITHOUT touching the app-level capacitor.config.json (which a future Hicks-lane Phase L mobile-renderer wave will own end-to-end).
_comment_w16_status: STUB — actual environment-bound values populated in W17+ when the mobile-bundle-ci.yml workflow is exercised against staging (staging-mobile.mahjong.example.com) and prod (mobile.mahjong.example.com). W16 lays the path-level groundwork; W17+ injects the real per-environment values via the docs/mobile-ci-bootstrap.md §4 secret matrix.

plugins._comment_plugins: Per-plugin runtime config. W16 stub; W17+ wires the real plugin set as the mobile-bundle-ci.yml exercises against a live build.
